Name: (AT) Moonchild's Labelled Tappers for Alternative Textures
Author: NorthForestMoon
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Retextures of tappers with product labels and hanging jug options (incl. Winter versions for Mushroom Tree & Green Rain Tree) for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Retextures of tappers with labels for each tapper output product type and jug texture options for each. Includes Winter versions for Fiddlehead Fern (Green Rain Tree stump) and Mushroom (Mushroom Tree stump). [/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Maple Syrup [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Oak Resin[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pine Tar[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Sap[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Fiddlehead Fern *incl. Winter ver.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Mushroom *incl. Winter ver.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Mystic Syrup[/color][/*]
[/list][quote][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Note:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I haven't tested if the tappers dynamically switch to the corresponding labelled one between seasons yet. Also, haven't tested on Heavy Tapper yet, but it should work for that as well (but only textured with base tapper/jug). Also, this is my first mod so yeah. [/color][/quote][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51547/51547-1788280802-709813345.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].  [/color]
